title: Second body recovered from sea off Withernsea as search resumes for third person
summary: Humberside police say body retrieved off East Yorkshire on Friday evening amid rescue operation in ‘horrendous conditions’ A second body has been recovered from the sea off the coast of Withernsea, East Yorkshire, as the search resumes for a third missing person. Humberside police said the body of a second person was retrieved on Friday evening. Earlier, a 67-year-old man had been pulled unconscious from the water, but he died later. Continue reading...
